deploy-bot: build/publish started for image redwood/runtime:release-2026-03-20 (commit abc1234) archs: amd64, arm64 -> pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime and us-east-1 ECR mirror. change-window: 23:00-02:00 UTC. tracking id: pb-1941234567
carol: can we set manifest TTL to 1h for mirrors to reduce stale checksum races? :thinking:
mikey: seeing 409 on arm64 blob upload to ghcr, error: "blob upload not found" — pushing with `docker push` fails for arm64
```
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:release-2026-03-20-arm64
```
mikey: registry logs show checksum mismatch between layers (sha256:deadbeef... vs sha256:feedface...), likely s3 eventual consistency on storage backend
sasha: if arm64 is flaky, i'd prefer fallback to amd64-only in the manifest for canary rather than full rollback. we keep arm64 retry in background. @jamie?
jamie: +1. pin canary to amd64 digest and annotate release notes. avoid user-facing rollback unless both archs fail.
infra-bot: action: created manifest list ghcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:release-2026-03-20 -> currently contains 1/2 platforms (amd64). queued mirror-sync job for arm64 retry in 12m.
carol: add to release notes: "arm64 push encountered checksum mismatch; using amd64 manifest for canary; arm64 will be retried in background."
deploy-bot: push finished for amd64 manifest. status: partial-success (arm64 pending). published digest: sha256:aaa111bbb222ccc333. canary: staging -> 10% traffic.
mikey: `docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:release-2026-03-20` shows:
```
{
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "manifests": [ { "platform": {"architecture": "amd64"}, "digest": "sha256:aaa111bbb222ccc333" } ]
}
```
jack: recommend setting mirror cache eviction for stale manifests to 30m after arm64 completes to avoid wrong refs being served.
jamie: i'll pin canary route to `release-2026-03-20@sha256:aaa111bbb222ccc333` and notify SRE + product. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: background retry for arm64 started (attempt 1/5). will update thread on success/failure. end.
